title: Sidebar collapsible sections: use NavTabSection and remount it on search start/stop
answers: How do I add a collapsible section to the Apps/Files sidebar?
Why does starting a search reopen collapsed sidebar sections?
How to hide Starred section when search has no matches
body:
Sidebar sections in Apps and Files use `NavTabSection` (frontend/src/layout/panel-layout/navbar/tabs/NavTabSection.tsx): props `label`, optional `collapsedLabel` (Project shows 'All apps' when collapsed), and `dataAttr` (e.g. `nav-apps-starred-toggle`). It uses local useState(true) and `Collapsible.Panel keepMounted`.
Search-opens-sections behavior is done by giving each section `key={`name-${!!search.trim()}`}` so it remounts open when search starts or stops; keep that pattern in NavTabApps.tsx and NavTabFiles.tsx.
Starred is hidden only when searching, data has loaded and there are zero starred matches: `(!search.trim() || !shortcutDataHasLoaded || starred.length > 0)`.
To wrap the ProjectTree body in a section, use the new `renderTree` prop on ProjectTree (ProjectTree.tsx); it also disables the tree's own scroll like `beforeTree`.
